proof: Last normalized vector z has squared norm <= C. Drop nonpositive output weights after ReLU. For positive w, w*ReLU(gamma*z+beta) <= w*abs(gamma*z)+w*abs(beta). Cauchy-Schwarz gives delta <= sqrt(C)*norm(w_positive*gamma)+sum(w_positive*abs(beta))+bias. First nonseed logit = -2.944439 + delta. No movement is possible if this upper bound is below 2.197224577.
